    obstacles = observation.get("obstacles", [])

    scores = observation.get("scores", {})

    opp_path = observation.get("opponent_path", [])

    x, y = pos[0], pos[1]

    def clamp(n):

        if n > 1:

        return n

    # Basic retreat from nearest opponent
    ox, oy = opp[0], opp[1]
    dx = x - ox
    dy = y - oy
    dist = abs(dx) + abs(dy)
    if dist > 0:
        rx = clamp(dx)
        ry = clamp(dy)
        return [rx, ry]

    # If on same cell as opponent, step away in any valid direction
    for mx in (-1, 0, 1):
        for my in (-1, 0, 1):

            nx, ny = x + mx, y + my
            if 0 <= nx < grid_w and 0 <= ny < grid_h:

    # Move toward nearest resource if available and safe
    best = None
    bestd = 10**9
    for r in resources:
        rx, ry = r[0], r[1]
        dd = abs(rx - x) + abs(ry - y)
        if dd < bestd:
